PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return (C-Section, Home, Mat Only)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary rehab:
    name "Safe postpartum return to strength"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Pre-Clearance Light Activity" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Walk and Breathe":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          ankle_circles 2x10 rpe 1 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          neck_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Walk and Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          arm_circles 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          marching 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          neck_roll 2m
      DAY Friday training 20m "Walk and Breathe":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          wrist_circles 2x10 rpe 1 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Walk and Breathe":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          ankle_circles 2x10 rpe 1 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          neck_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Walk and Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          arm_circles 2x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          marching 2x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          neck_roll 2m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Walk and Breathe":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          wrist_circles 2x10 rpe 1 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 2m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Post Six-Week Clearance Foundations" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Core Reconnection A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          prone_Y 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core Reconnection B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          squat 2x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Core Reconnection C":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x5 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          prone_W 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Core Reconnection A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          prone_Y 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core Reconnection B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          squat 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Core Reconnection C":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 2x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          prone_W 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Foundations A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          prone_T 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Foundations B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          prone_Y 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          clam_free_hip_note_placeholder 0x0 rpe 0 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          figure_four_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Foundations C":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
